shots.beat: Welcome to 2196: a slow tilt up from the overgrown avenue (trees in the road, a temporal zone glowing on it) to the tower canyon of Rain City a hundred and forty-seven years on: vines on the facades, the fallen tower face leaning across the avenue, haze and a slit of morning sky.
shots.characters: none (the Reach itself; Kai stands at the landing, too small and shaded to read)
shots.lighting: Morning haze from the far end of the avenue, vines on the sunlit tower, the zone's cold glow; the near tower in shade.
shots.sound: 2196 bed: processed wind, birds, a far bell. Sera's line over it.
shots.notes: g5: a tilt-up reveal along the avenue axis (camera 16-18 m up, above the canopy, pushing 7 m north) instead of the storyboard's oblique aerial, whose two near tower walls filled two thirds of the frame. Descending into the canopy was tried and rejected (tree crowns crossing the lens, the shaded road reads as a dark mass). Kai is not featured: from any height above the trees he is a dark speck on the shaded road; s18 carries him.

preview.note: g5 final: tilt-up from the overgrown avenue and the glowing zone to the vine-hung tower canyon and the sky slit.

shots.beat: The memorial square: Kai walks away from the lens toward a bronze statue of himself standing in the ring of a machine, and lifts his head to its face; the plaque below reads KAI VAREN · ARCHITECT OF THE FRACTURE.

(()=>{let iv=null; __game.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh && o.name==='ivy') iv=o; }); if(!iv) return 'no ivy'; const a=iv.geometry.attributes.position; let n=0; for(let i=0;i<a.count;i++){ const x=a.getX(i),y=a.getY(i),z=a.getZ(i); if(x>-10.5&&x<-5.5&&z>-51.6&&z<-51.0&&y<2.2){ a.setZ(i,-55); n++; } } a.needsUpdate=true; iv.geometry.computeBoundingSphere(); return 'ivy off the plaque: '+n})()

shots.characters: Kai (back to camera, walking in from beside the lens, stopping right of the plaque and looking up); the bronze statue
shots.lighting: Low angle against the morning sky; a warm run-time key on the bronze from the camera side so it reads as metal, not a silhouette; the plaque lamp moved 2 m forward and up (it burned out the ivy beside the plaque).
shots.notes: g5: Kai walks on the touch stick (0.3 = walk) with player.camYaw pinned to 0 for the shot (the game's camera yaw drifts behind a moving Kai and bent his path). His path runs between the plaque and the east bush (the bush at (-4.5, -47.4) has no collision: an earlier path walked through it). The ivy patch hanging in front of the plaque (472 vertices of the merged ivy mesh) is pushed inside the plinth so ARCHITECT OF THE FRACTURE stays legible. Focus on the statue's head: Kai walks from soft into the focal plane. The memorial cutscene's trigger is registered later in the mission, so the square is free to stage.

preview.note: g5 final: Kai walks away from the lens to stand beneath his bronze statue; the plaque reads KAI VAREN · ARCHITECT OF THE FRACTURE.

shots.beat: Montage: Halden General's reversed East Corridor, seen from the lab through its empty window: the glass that burst at 08:14 lifts off the floor around Kai, flies back at the lens and seals into the pane, with Kai behind it.
shots.characters: Kai (facing camera in the corridor beyond the window, looking down at the glass, then up as it rises)
shots.lighting: The corridor's cold ceiling panels behind and above Kai; the dim lab around the window frame; the hazards' floor rings glowing.
shots.notes: g5: camera inside the lab (x 29..35, z -2.4..1) pushing 0.35 m toward the window opening (x 30.5..33.5), which fills the frame. The corridor zone's reversal rate is slowed to 0.45 at run time (zCorr.dir) so the 0.8 s glass return plays over 1.8 s (t 0.45 -> 2.23, sealed before the cut-out); everything in the corridor slows together. game.control is off for the shot (no hazard hits; the mission is still waiting at the cordon, |x| > 9). The storyboard's corridor angle was replaced: plain walls, small hazards, Kai at the frame edge.

preview.note: g5 final: through the lab window, the 08:14 glass flies back at the lens in slow motion and seals into the pane with Kai behind it.

shots.beat: Montage: Dr. Yara Lind, stopped mid-stride inside the containment field for three days, seen from beyond the vessel through its glowing rings as the camera slides past her.
shots.characters: Yara (frozen mid-run toward the vessel, facing camera)
shots.lighting: The vessel's cyan rings in the foreground (soft, out of focus), cold field light on her face; the chamber door behind her.
shots.notes: g5: camera on the far (north) side of the containment vessel, dollying 1.1 m sideways so the rings slide past in front of a motionless Yara (parallax sells the stopped time); focus on her head. Kai is placed inside the chamber out of frame so mission 8 lights the chamber zone (its zone follows Kai, and from the mission start it rendered with the street/rain settings).

preview.note: g5 final: Yara frozen mid-stride, seen through the vessel rings sliding past in the foreground.

shots.beat: Montage: the Eastway at night, the sea of 2196 poured into 2049's highway: from just above the churning water, Kai stranded on the roof of a submerged van under the gantry sign HELIX 7 · KEEP LEFT · FLOODING, rain driving down.

(async()=>{const T=await import('/vendor/three.module.min.js'); const w=__m18.W.water, m=w.material, U=m.userData.rzUniforms; const d=U.rzWD.value.image.data, h=T.DataUtils; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ d[i]=h.toHalfFloat(h.fromHalfFloat(d[i])+1.05); d[i+1]=h.toHalfFloat(0.55); } U.rzWD.value.needsUpdate=true; m.envMapIntensity=2.5; U.rzWaves.value=1.3; U.rzSpecMax.value=30; return 'flood: depth +1.05 m, foam 0.55'})()

shots.characters: Kai (on the van roof, looking down the flooded road toward the stalled N4 bus)
shots.lighting: Night rain, sodium lamps, the lit gantry sign; foam-streaked flood water a hand's width below the lens.
shots.notes: g5: the surge is held at its peak (S.t = 0.72 period, control off so the cycle and the swept-away fail stay still; set after Kai is placed, because Kai crossing z 30 makes the mission reset S.t). The game's flood shader keeps the depth map baked at the 0.3 m base level, so at surge height it still renders a transparent film with the road markings showing through: the trailer adds the surge height to the depth map and a foam mask at run time, and raises the reflections (envMapIntensity 2.5, waves 1.3). Game note for the missions workflow: the surge water reads poorly in play for the same reason.

preview.note: g5 final: from just above the churning surge, Kai stranded on a submerged van under the HELIX 7 · FLOODING gantry, rain driving down.

shots.beat: Montage: the Corran Building from over the river, its upper thirty floors torn away by the storm: broken column stubs and a water tank on the open frame, its roof crane's jib fallen across the gorge, violet storm light behind.

setup.eval: (()=>{let n=0; __game.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.name==='skyline'){ o.visible=false; n++; } }); return 'skyline hidden: '+n})()

shots.lighting: Low drone over the river toward the tower; the violet-to-amber storm wall on the horizon; storm cells glowing inside the floors.
shots.notes: g5: replaced the storyboard's look up the south face (a plain grid against a grey sky) with the view from the east over the river, which shows the torn-off top and the fallen jib. The chapter's distant skyline set (flat-shaded boxes in the haze, 170-300 m out) is hidden at run time so the storm wall forms the horizon.

preview.note: g5 final: from over the river, the Corran frame with its torn-off top and fallen crane jib against the violet storm.

shots.beat: Montage: the storm front bearing down on Lantern Hall as its anchor fails: from above the gate, the settlement's garden beds, stalls, lantern strings and iron trusses run to the beacon, and the violet wall of loose time advances behind it while the last survivors hurry for the gate.

setup.eval: (()=>{__game.control=false; __m18.S.anchor=0.34; window.__stormT=null; window.__stormHook=__game.onUpdate(dt=>{ if(window.__stormT!=null){ __stormT+=dt; __m18.S.anchor=Math.max(0.05, 0.34-__stormT*0.11); } }); return 'storm hook: anchor 0.34 -> 0.12 over the shot'})()

shots.characters: Survivors (small: Ama leaving her beds, the teacher on the east platform, Joss at the beacon)
shots.lighting: The storm wall's violet and cyan light behind the hall's north wall; lantern strings and the cook fire inside.
shots.notes: g5: the storm front is set from the anchor (front = -132 - 150 * anchor): a run-time hook lowers the anchor from 0.34 to 0.12 over the shot, so the wall advances about 33 m toward the beacon while the camera pushes in. game.control is off for the shot (the mission's own anchor drain and the anchor-fail trigger only run with control). Tried and rejected: low views in the aisle and at the beacon (the hall's north brick wall fills the frame and the storm reads as a flat backdrop).

preview.note: Lantern Hall trusses under violet storm light.
